title: Lane Community College International Programs
markdown:
**Lane Community College** is a**two-year college** located in [Eugene, Oregon](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Eugene,_Oregon "Eugene, Oregon"), [United States](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/United_States "United States"), on a 314-acre campus in southeast Eugene, with additional facilities in downtown Eugene, [Florence](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Florence,_Oregon "Florence, Oregon"), [Cottage Grove](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Cottage_Grove,_Oregon "Cottage Grove, Oregon"), and the Lane Aviation Academy at [Eugene Airport](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Eugene_Airport "Eugene Airport"). Lane serves more than 26,000 credit and non-credit students annually in a 5,000 square-mile (~8047 km2) service district, including most of [Lane County](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Lane_County,_Oregon "Lane County, Oregon") as well as individual school districts in [Benton](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Benton_County,_Oregon "Benton County, Oregon"), [Linn](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Linn_County,_Oregon "Linn County, Oregon"), and [Douglas](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Douglas_County,_Oregon "Douglas County, Oregon") counties. Its [motto](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Motto "Motto") is *Transforming Lives Through Learning*.
No TOEFL/No SAT
